implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter with openai_responses:gpt-5-mini for all generation calls. Flow: (1) deterministic input topology+intent manifest → single shared initial generation call per confirmatory task (one model call). (2) Run deterministic vendor-specific parser/round-trip checks. (3) For parser-passing samples, execute automated baseline validator (deterministic binary outcome). (4) For guarded condition, run deterministic Docker-based sandbox emulation harness that consumes serialized emulation artifacts derived from the generated config; map deterministic emulation observations to binary detection per pre-registered mapping rules. (5) When initial candidate fails validator semantics and mapping warrants repair, invoke up to one guarded repair generation call per task per adapter contract. All orchestration, parser binaries, validator, and Docker emulators run on CPU/Docker; no local GPU, no human labour. All artifacts, checksums, seeds and model-returned sampling metadata recorded in execution manifest.
public_resources: Transformation code (parser/serializer, fault injector, emulation generator) will be published as open-source repository with checksums.
Execution manifest and raw artifacts to be released subject to provider TOS and public datasets only policy.
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (openai_responses) — single hosted model for all generation and repair calls; model_version=gpt-5-mini
task_manifest_strategy: Pre-generate intent+topology manifests deterministically from seeded PRNG; each manifest hashed (SHA-256) and stored. Only parser-passing manifests advance to confirmatory pipelines; parser failures trigger deterministic reseed up to two times as per missingness_plan.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use deterministic vendor-specific serializers/parsers and pre-registered injected misconfiguration templates. Round-trip parse/serialize equivalence required. Mapping rules from injected template→emulation test are pre-validated during discovery (registered as immutable mapping files with checksums).
execution_batches: 8 batches of 90 confirmatory tasks (tasks 1–90, 91–180, 181–270, 271–360, 361–450, 451–540, 541–630, 631–720). Each batch: run initial generation for all tasks, run parser+validator, run emulator for guarded condition, then run repair calls for tasks flagged for repair (bounded by one repair call per task).
Batch sequencing uses fixed PRNG seed to assign task order; batches executed sequentially to simplify emulation resource management within 7-day wall-clock limit.
randomisation_plan: Task ordering into batches is pseudo-random using a fixed, preregistered PRNG seed (recorded in manifest). Within-batch processing order is predetermined by ascending task index. No randomisation of condition generation (shared initial candidate per paired design).
caching_plan: Cache model outputs, parser/validator outputs, emulation traces, and checksums in an immutable artifact store. Cache keys = SHA-256(task_manifest || model prompt || model sampling metadata). Reuse cached artifacts if identical inputs reoccur; otherwise treat as distinct. All cache hits and misses logged deterministically.
failure_recovery_plan: Follow preregistered missingness_plan: automatic deterministic retries up to two times for transient failures (provider timeouts, emulation harness crashes, parser failures). If failure persists, perform deterministic reseed and replace sample per contamination_plan; record as technical exclusion. Primary analysis excludes irrecoverable technical pairs (complete_pair_primary); sensitivity analysis treats irrecoverable guarded failures as nondetections (zero).
result_schema: Schema paired_binary_episode_v1: fields per episode = {task_id:int, task_hash:hex, vendor_family:string, topology_template:string, misconfig_class:string, initial_generation_prompt:text, model_sampling_metadata:json, parser_pass:boolean, detected_by_baseline:{0,1}, emulation_verdict:boolean, detected_by_guarded:{0,1}, repair_performed:boolean, repair_generation_output:text, validator_rule_ids:list, emulation_observations:list, timestamps:iso8601, artifact_checksums:{parser:hex, validator:hex, emulator:hex}, failure_flags:list}. Deterministic scoring maps emulation_observations→detected_by_guarded per pre-registered mapping table.
estimated_compute_notes: Derivation: confirmatory task_count = 720 → one initial generation call per task = 720 calls. Estimated additional repair calls = 80 (expected repair demand ≈11% based on pilot/discovery prior runs), so estimated_model_calls = 720 + 80 = 800. Adapter-imposed maximum_model_calls = task_count * 2 = 720 * 2 = 1440 (worst-case if every task requires one repair). All model calls are hosted API calls (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini). Emulation: Docker-based CPU emulation per sample expected median CPU time ≈ 45s; concurrent emulation configured to meet 7-day wall-clock limit given batch sizing. All compute, storage, and network usage estimates recorded in execution manifest and final compute-cost summary.
